kept.title: File:Mesopotamian - Cylinder Seal - Walters 42564 - Impression.jpg
kept.credit: Walters Art Museum: Home page Info about artwork
kept.desc: The variety of mythological scenes increased dramatically during the Akkadian period. In this seal, a seated vegetation goddess is greeted by three other deities. Stalks of grain sprout from the females, while tree branches grow from the two males, perhaps referring to a specific myth.
kept.attribution: Anonymous (Mesopotamia)Unknown author / Wikimedia Commons / Public domain
